security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: File manager for SFTP, SCP, FTP, WebDAV, S3
bundle.longDescription: Rust Commander is a dual-pane file manager and transfer client: SFTP, SCP, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV, S3, Azure and Google Cloud Storage, synchronization, an integrated editor and terminal, a headless web mode and LAN discovery of other instances.
